name: @awacloud/oconv-fonts
description: The SIL OFL companion of @awacloud/oconv — vendored Liberation 2.1.5 Sans/Serif/Mono font faces (12 TrueType programs, Regular/Bold/Italic/BoldItalic) registered as an @awacloud/fw descriptor by name, so oconv's md → pdf route embeds real faces by default instead of falling back to the PDF Standard 14. Optional at every layer: absent from the runtime, oconv still resolves to Standard 14 and the module graph still links. Zero runtime dependency beyond @awacloud/fw.

awa._coverageComment: Basis = this package's own src/** JS surface (src/main.js, src/faces.js, src/loader.js — 3 lcov rows). The unfiltered/canonical aggregate is not usable as a basis: this package's tarball payload is dominated by 4 359 164 B of vendored Liberation TrueType font programs (vendor/liberation/*.ttf), which are binary font data, not instrumentable JS — no coverage percentage may describe them. Measured 2026-09-18: `bun cli.ts coverage-gate --scopes packages/front/office/oconv-fonts/` -> 100.00% lines over 3 basis rows (awa.coverageBasis). floor = max(0, floor(100) - 2)/100 = 0.98.

author: Matthieu Bouilloux
